integrity: Analytic Riccati perturbation and an independently replayable analytic/numerical diagnostic checker; claims of independent certification are not made.
scientific_limitations: Linearized two-compartment disease-free model; all-parameter quadratic coefficient and unique phase optimizer proved only to leading nonzero weak-forcing order; finite-amplitude, nonlinear, outbreak-probability and empirical predictions not established; historical priority provisional.
title: Exact weak-seasonality phase law for bidirectional vector–host transmission
